paragraphs: R' Chiyya son of Rav Yeiva, Sukkah 42b.
Rav Chanin son of Rav Yeiva, Bava Batra 174a.
Rav Sama son of Rav Yeiva, Bava Batra 9; Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Safra, as does Bava Batra 5a. Rami son of Rav Yeiva, Shabbat 83a.
Rav Shmuel bar Yeiva, Niddah 15b. But almost all of them lived in different times.

notes.text: The Sama/Safra reading is Hyman’s reported variant. This is a collective list: Hyman expressly says that almost all these figures lived at different times.
